title: Stability of Branching Multiplicities for Orthogonal Gelfand Pairs
summary: We propose a structural framework for branching multiplicities in representation theory, emphasizing their behavior under variation of infinitesimal characters. For the orthogonal reductive pairs $(G,G')$ with complexified Lie algebras $(\mathfrak{o}(n+1,\mathbb{C}), \mathfrak{o}(n,\mathbb{C}))$, we show that branching multiplicities are governed by universal systems of linear inequalities on the parameter space of reduced coherent families introduced in this paper.
